verdict.rationale: Helicone publishes an OpenAPI/swagger.json spec and REST endpoint docs with curl examples (e.g., helicone-probe-3, helicone-docs-15/32), and separately offers a Playground for testing prompts/sessions in the UI (helicone-gh-3/6). However, there's no confirmed 'try-it-now' interactive console rendered from the OpenAPI spec (e.g., Swagger UI with live execution) tying the API reference itself to runnable examples. Missing for 10: evidence of an actual interactive API console/try-it-out feature in the docs site, and confirmation the Playground covers the REST API reference rather than just prompt/session testing.
